title: pattern

gpu_support.notes: Pattern text is host-only; numeric resident handles reject without implicit text conversion or provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: pat = pattern(text) - Create a literal string pattern.
behaviors: Pattern objects are accepted by matches, contains, startsWith, endsWith, erase, replace, and the boundary helpers added in this compatibility group.
Literal pattern text is escaped before matching.
Integer and other numeric inputs have no semantic role and reject without conversion; this includes resident numeric handles.
examples: pattern("run") creates a literal pattern object for pattern-aware string APIs.
